t2.thesis: Gap enters Q3 earnings with heavily compressed expectations and valuation after a 15% 1-month drop, creating favorable asymmetry supported by positive call IV skew and high short interest.
reasons: Forward P/E sits at just ~7.6x following a sharp pre-earnings pullback (-7.8% 5-day, -15.4% 1-month), setting a low bar for a relief move.
ATM call implied volatility trades 24.4 points above put IV despite elevated put volume, signaling robust institutional demand for upside convexity.
High short interest (12.6% of float) provides squeeze potential if Q3 sales top consensus as previewed by UBS.
t2.deciding_variable: Old Navy comparable sales trajectory and holiday quarter margin guidance.
t2.moved_from_prior: Moved up +0.025 from the consumer prior of 0.555 to 0.58 due to washed-out positioning, steep call IV skew, and single-digit valuation cushion.

theses.expected: Old Navy comp stabilization and sustained Gap brand momentum produce a modest top/bottom-line beat, triggering a short squeeze and multiple expansion.
theses.mechanism: With 12.6% short interest and depressed pre-print sentiment, inline or slightly better Q3 execution forces shorts to cover into a cheap multiple.
theses.wrong_if: Old Navy promotional headwinds accelerate and holiday gross margin guidance is cut due to consumer softness.

theses.expected: Q3 results meet lowered targets but Q4 outlook is cautious, leaving the stock rangebound to down.
theses.mechanism: Management emphasizes macro and discretionary consumer headwinds into the holidays, dampening full-year EPS expectations.
theses.wrong_if: Strong margin discipline and IEEPA tariff tailwinds keep full-year EPS guide resilient.

theses.expected: Sharp negative revision at Athleta and Old Navy drives a guidance cut.
theses.mechanism: Turnaround execution lags, leading to inventory build and promotional margin erosion.
theses.wrong_if: Gap brand strength and corporate cost discipline offset brand-level laggards.

key_observations: Old Navy comparable store sales relative to -4% in Q2
Full-year fiscal 2026 adjusted EPS guidance range (previously $2.35-$2.45)
Gross margin performance versus Q3 guidance of +25 to +75 bps YoY
Holiday quarter commentary regarding promotional cadence and inventory levels
t2.method: D004 v4: leak-probe call without the dossier, then one decision call on the frozen dossier; no tools
